recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Revisit only if OO later decides to add a distinct child-facing search parameter or element; FHIR-38733 itself has already been applied correctly and adding redundant wording would increase maintenance drift.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Specimen active and approved. Current source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml and bundle-Specimen-search-params.xml retain Specimen.parent and the parent search parameter, while source/specimen/specimen-notes.xml points to search.html#has for recursive or reverse child-based search. OO 2023-01-30 minutes corroborate the search-needs discussion and 4-0-0 approval. FHIR-38732 is supporting context for grouping text, and FHIR-39269 is background about Group retaining Specimen members and is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because the current Specimen Notes already contain the approved guidance and the conformance source correctly retains the parent-oriented relationship.
